name: Water Heater Installation

faqs.question: How long does water heater installation take?
faqs.answer: Tank water heater installation typically takes 3-4 hours. Tankless installations may take 4-8 hours depending on gas line and venting requirements.

faqs.question: Should I choose tank or tankless?
faqs.answer: We'll help you decide based on your household size, hot water usage, energy goals, and budget. Both have advantages depending on your needs.

faqs.question: What size water heater do I need?
faqs.answer: We calculate the right size based on your household size, number of bathrooms, and hot water usage patterns to ensure adequate supply.

faqs.question: Do you remove old water heaters?
faqs.answer: Yes, we remove and properly dispose of your old water heater as part of our installation service.

faqs.question: Can you install gas and electric water heaters?
faqs.answer: Yes, we install both gas and electric water heaters, including necessary gas line work, electrical connections, and venting.

faqs.question: Do you install expansion tanks?
faqs.answer: Yes, we install expansion tanks when required by code or recommended for your plumbing system to prevent pressure issues.

faqs.question: What brands do you install?
faqs.answer: We install all major brands including Rheem, Bradford White, AO Smith, Rinnai, Navien, and Noritz, and can recommend the best for your needs.

faqs.question: Do you offer warranties?
faqs.answer: Yes, we provide warranty coverage on both the water heater unit (manufacturer warranty) and our installation labor.

description: Professional water heater installation for tank and tankless systems
